dsp GenFm3branch3x7Organ where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * 0.5
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 7.0 / sr))
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * depth + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth * 0.6
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6413

dsp GenFm3stack2x5Organ where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * 0.5
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 5.0 / sr))
    let m3 := sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0 + m3) * depth
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6605

dsp GenFm3branch2x5Organ where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * 0.5
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 5.0 / sr))
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * depth + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth * 0.6
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6948

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * 0.5
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 1.41 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 2.82 / sr))
    let m3 := sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0 + m3) * depth
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6383

dsp GenFm3branch1p41x2p82Swell where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * (0.3 + ienvA * 0.7)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 1.41 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 2.82 / sr))
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * depth + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth * 0.6
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6355

  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0

    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 2.82 / sr))

dsp GenFm3stack0p5x1Swell where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * (0.3 + ienvA * 0.7)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let m3 := sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0 + m3) * depth
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.7121

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.4 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA

    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * depth + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth * 0.6
    set previous := gate

dsp GenFm3stack4x1Strike where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * (0.3 + ienvA * 0.7)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 4.0 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let m3 := sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0 + m3) * depth
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6806

dsp GenFm3branch4x1Strike where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * (0.3 + ienvA * 0.7)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 4.0 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * depth + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth * 0.6
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.7141

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0

    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))

    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 14.0 / sr))

    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0 + m3) * depth
    set previous := gate

dsp GenFm3stack1x14Organ where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * 0.5
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 14.0 / sr))
    let m3 := sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0 + m3) * depth
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6328

dsp GenFm3branch1x14Organ where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * 0.5
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 14.0 / sr))
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * depth + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth * 0.6
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6878

dsp GenFm3stack3p5x1p5Organ where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * 0.5
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 3.5 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    let m3 := sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0 + m3) * depth
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6493

dsp GenFm3branch3p5x1p5Organ where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let depth := (0.3 + colour * 1.8) * 0.5
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 3.5 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    let m2 := sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * depth + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * depth * 0.6
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(p1 * 2.0 + m2) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6346

    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate

dsp GenSubSawLeadLp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let raw := ((ph0 * 2.0 - 1.0 - select(lt(ph0, dt0), (ph0 / dt0) * 2.0 - (ph0 / dt0) * (ph0 / dt0) - 1.0, select(gt(ph0, 1.0 - dt0), ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) + ((ph0 - 1.0) / dt0) * 2.0 + 1.0, 0.0)))) * 1.0 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 0.9
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2f) * 0.9) * 0.6468
